## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-ras-assess`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-ras-assess -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `pointers.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `pointers.jsonl`
- `readbacks/2026-09-24-route-map.json`
- `readbacks/2026-09-24-public-source-readback.json`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

# RAS assessment: find the evidence, then request the work

> **Start here — free verify:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) (or the free MCP tool `verify_card` at `https://councilof.ai/mcp`) · **Full catalog:** [https://councilof.ai/catalog.json](https://councilof.ai/catalog.json) · Methodology: [https://councilof.ai/methodology/](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · Measurement, not certification.

CSOAI is building a public, continuous and independently verifiable measurement layer for AI governance, financial rails and the agent economy. Each record must disclose its actual signature, witness and anchor state; some records are unsigned or uncheckable. CSOAI does not certify, accredit, endorse or sell a favourable result. Payment cannot turn an unmeasured subject into a measured one.

This is a pointer dataset, not a current board or customer list. Its seven pointers and two manifest rows were assembled on 4 September 2026. Re-fetch the live routes for current states and prices; do not treat the dated rows as live counts.

## Start with free public evidence

| Need | Canonical route | What it establishes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GSPC board | [Live board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) | Per-axis state, sample size and source references at the board's stated time. MEASURED records a run; it does not prove a worker is running now. |
| Verify a card | [Free verification](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify) · [method](https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md) | Whether available card bytes and a signature can be checked. Missing proof remains UNCHECKABLE. |
| Claim status | [Claim register](https://councilof.ai/api/claims/register) | Dated claim states. UNMEASURED, UNCHECKABLE and superseded remain distinct. |
| Evidence doors | [x402 catalogue](https://councilof.ai/api/x402) · [discovery](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json) | Resource listings, not proof of purchase or delivery. |
| Settlement evidence | [Revenue API](https://councilof.ai/api/revenue) | Reported external settlement and payer distinctions. Self-funded tests are not demand. |
| Agent interface | [A2A card](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json) · [MCP endpoint](https://councilof.ai/mcp) | Declared capabilities and callable protocol locations. A listing is not adoption. |

A public API readback at **24 September 2026, 21:05 UTC** found **23 board axes marked MEASURED** and **21 x402 resources catalogued**. These are separate denominators: they do not mean 23 continuously running workers or 21 paying users. Re-fetch the APIs for present state.

## Request a named assessment

A person can start at the [assessment page](https://councilof.ai/assess/). An agent can inspect the existing [request-attestation door](https://councilof.ai/api/request-attestation?subject=csoai) for a named subject. The tested door returned an HTTP 402 challenge with live terms. A challenge is not a settlement, completed measurement, signed receipt or sale. Read the live challenge for any price. Verification and the public board remain free.

The useful work sequence is: name the exact subject and question → inspect existing evidence and gaps → agree any new measurement scope → run and review it → deliver evidence with its actual signature and witness state → monitor named dependencies and correct changed claims. Commissioned work and monitoring are offered pathways, not claims that every step is automated or has a buyer today. A signature authenticates bytes from a key; it does not establish the underlying claim. A Bitcoin anchor requires separate verifiable proof.

## Reuse these files correctly

The pointers file names authority routes; the manifest describes this repository's dated files. Neither is a scored subject dataset. Other [CSOAI datasets](https://huggingface.co/csoai) have their own dates and provenance. For current GSPC state, start with the [live board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc).

## Dated public-source readback

[24 September source intake: 12 bounded probes](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/ras-assess/blob/6998c71a9b967f4446236098c0b6f6e5d87fc322/readbacks/2026-09-24-public-source-readback.json) records the response shape, time and SHA-256 for one public request each to MCP Registry, Hugging Face models/datasets/Spaces, two x402 directories, FDIC institutions/financials, two SEC sample endpoints, a community A2A registry and an XRPL public node. It is a connectivity and source-intake readback, not a full census, named-subject measurement, customer-use signal or continuously running worker. The file itself is unsigned and unanchored; re-fetch a source to assess its current state.

## Dated RAS route map

[24 September route map: 23 GSPC axis slugs and 21 catalogued x402 resources](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/ras-assess/blob/7342765e44179acc7666bdc07b59ecd8c5e25940/readbacks/2026-09-24-route-map.json) groups the existing routes for agent navigation. It cites hashes of the source APIs and includes the dated claim and revenue states. These groups are not running specialist hives; a catalogued route is not a tested execution, sale or fresh measurement. The map is unsigned and has no verified Bitcoin anchor. Re-fetch the canonical APIs for current state.
